intro: Every item below answers a problem that showed up in real Guam Google reviews. Scanned 2026-07 to 2026-09, five businesses, 388 reviews.

groups.evidence: 4 of 5 scanned Guam businesses. Happy and unhappy reviews alike sit unanswered, so the unhappy ones are the last word.

groups.problem: Customers show up with the wrong expectations.
groups.evidence: 3 of 5. Walk-ins turned away, a deposit rule nobody explained, booked with a different tech than expected.
No website beyond directory listings, or an unclaimed Google profile.
Not yet seen in salon or trade reviews. Seen once at a Guam clinic. Only you know your real number.

groups.problem: Not sure where AI would even help.
groups.evidence: Start here. The scan reads your reviews and site and says what it sees, nothing more.
An app, a workflow, or steady AI work every week.
